name: Montana 4-H Foundation Youth Representative
what_you_do: Serve as a youth member of the Montana 4-H Foundation board of trustees. The Foundation raises private funds for the 4-H program.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 18. You must be a 4-H member in your home county for at least three consecutive years. You need your county agent's approval.
pay_detail: Unpaid board seat. Cost not stated on the program page.
duration: Two-year term (the page says it will change to one year)
deadline_text: Send the application before November 1. The page does not name the year, so check the date with the 4-H Foundation.
how_to_apply: Fill out the application and send it. Email is preferred. You can also text 406-624-9835, fax 406-994-5417 or mail it to Montana 4-H Foundation, Inc., PO Box 173580, Bozeman.
notes: The page lists two at-large youth seats. Ask your county agent early because their approval is required.
